notes.title: Christmas Event 2024!
notes.content:
Hello Kado Hunter!

Christmas is coming to Vanada! 
The preparations are running - but even the elves have some trouble to get things perfectly done.
Visit the event area in the KADO SHOP and feel the glow of this years Christmas!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/5hKzqTp/eventstart.png[/img]

There are 3 minigames waiting for you:

[h1][b]-	Snowblaster (at Snolf):[/b][/h1]
Hit as many snowmen as possible with the skill "Snowball".

[img]https://i.ibb.co/3y13QBD/snowballer.png[/img]

[h1][b]-	Fishing strawberry jam(at Cookielf)[/b][/h1]
Collect strawberry jam jars and deposit them into the cart. You'll help with that, so the cookies are able to be baked again!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/tZrDbbm/angeln.png[/img]

[h1][b]-	Christmas bakery(at Bakelf, in the bakery)[/b][/h1]
After you've collected all strawberry jam jars, you can help the elves baking cookies!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/fXWBQnM/backen.png[/img]


Receive "christmas market coupons" by playing the minigames and trade them with Frosty for christmas boosters!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/wKWY0N7/frosty.png[/img]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/zZKqbHY/booster.png[/img]

What isn't allowed to be missed at Christmas? Correct! Presents!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/qm5nBgv/chests.png[/img]

Beneath the fir trees there are several presents - sadly we, the SaltyDevs, forgot the number code...
Visit our Discord-Server and help us to solve the riddle, to unlock the presents again! (The riddle-phase is starting by 20th of December 2024, only on Discord!)

To our Discord-Server: https://discord.gg/2n2WSFryuJ


We wish you all a merry Christmas and a happy new year!


Your SaltyDevs!

notes.title: KADO MASTERS!
notes.content:
Greetings KADO HUNTER!

As we mentioned a few days ago, the new Autumn Update is now ready!
With that we implemented following changes:


-> The Halloween event is now finished and can't be entered anymore. If you are still in the event room, then you are still able to spend your leftovers Spooky Coins. After you leave the room, there is no way back in again!

-> KADO MASTERS is now playable! A card game that is testing strength and tactics. And of course there are also many things to collect! You can start it by speaking and winning against the NPC "Nicola" in the KADO SHOP.

[h1]A few important things about KADO MASTERS summared:[/h1]


[b]START:[/b]
You need to talk to Nicola in the KADO SHOP and defeat him to compete against many other people.

[b]SYMBOL:[/b]
Enemies can be recognized by the symbol over their heads (red or green KADOS). If it's red, it means you haven't won against this opponent yet. If it's green, it means you already defeated him/her.

[url=https://i.ibb.co/vZpJZ2x/km-symbol.png][img]https://i.ibb.co/vZpJZ2x/km-symbol.png[/img][/url]

[b]MANUAL:[/b]
After defeating Nicola you receive a manual. If you are not familiar about the games principle, you should read the manual carefully!

[b]REWARDS:[/b]
The winner of a match is receiving a random Kado Masters Kado (short KM Kado) of the opponent. CAUTION: You can also lose KADOS the same way!

[b]ALBUM:[/b]
Go and visit MIKO (KADO SHOP) regularly, to insert the KM-KADOS into your KADO ALBUM. This is possible with the "UPDATE KM KADO" function when you speak to MIKO.

[url=https://i.ibb.co/vzcZ1Fk/2024-12-01-01-36-17-online-video-cutter-com.gif][img]https://i.ibb.co/vzcZ1Fk/2024-12-01-01-36-17-online-video-cutter-com.gif[/img][/url]

And now we hope you'll enjoy and be successful on the way of the KADO HUNTER and the way of the KADO MASTER!

notes.title: Halloween event is coming to an end + card fight minigame!
notes.content:
Hello KADO HUNTER!

The Halloween-Event is slowly but surely coming to an end. So if you haven't collected all the [b]limited [/b]Halloween KADOS yet, then you should definitely do so. These will be removed from the game on December 1st, 2024!

But don't worry, you don’t have to wait that long for new updates. 😉
We'll be releasing an interactive card battle mini-game over the next few days! This means you can not only examine the beautiful KADOS - and everything else you could do - but also battle others with them!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/zSDG8GC/kamago.png[/img]

[img]https://i.ibb.co/QJdv15g/KMKADOS.png[/img]

Some people might already recognize it. 😉

Until then, have fun!

Your SaltyDevs!

notes.title: HALLOWEEN UPDATE
notes.content:
[h1][b]!!!IMPORTANT!!!
If your Kado album is empty after an update, just visit KADO-TRADER Miko and click on “Update Kado Album”! This will bring your Kado album back to its normal state! Please excuse these circumstances![/b][/h1]

 [img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45038323/30bb0ad7847b4a39d68a8db6dfe5e7f5878bd1bb.png[/img]

Happy Halloween, KADO HUNTER! The ZPOOKIEST time of the year stands before! 
…
You don’t know what Halloween is? Then it’s time! Zpooky from the Halloween-Committee will send Jacko to Vanada to get y’all in touch with Halloween!  
You’ll find Jacko in the upper floor in the Kado Shop – just follow the stairs beside the pumpkin. Jacko has – as far as I know – brought some sweets. ;)
 
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45038323/3e00129e3b535043d9a30ac31de803496444fcf7.png[/img]

In case you forget:
You get Spooky-Coins by defeating ghostly or demonic enemies as well as in the clay jars within the dungeons:

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45038323/3c14bca7725f3a386a6b14721fb8109de3bbf490.png[/img] [img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45038323/ba4220a6e8102ef82bd609ea5e60694b3b644c86.png[/img] [img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45038323/3ad3fcdb7ac9bf2f80864d8f3787d60968133c20.png[/img]
    

We hope you’ll enjoy it!
Your SaltyDevs!

notes.title: Roadmap 2024 / 2025 for KADO HUNTER
notes.content:
Greetings KADO HUNTER!

After releasing the early access we created more ideas and thought about the further way of KADO HUNTER. We want to give you some insights into the updates, we plan to release soon. We pictured a roadmap 2024 - 2025, while the contents for 2025 isn't completed at this point and will eventually change.

We are most excited about the seasonal events (as soon as it's time for that :D)


Please don't forget to give us feedback to our game and bugs, you maybe got into. We want to make this gaming experience better for you!

We wish you much fun!

Your SaltyGames-Devs!
